songs.title: i never decided to stay
songs.description: Soul pop for a cafe, C minor lifting to E flat major, 90 BPM. Female vocal in a low alto, low, settled, close-mic, behind the beat, little vibrato. Narrow melody, small steps inside a fourth, one short phrase returning; the chorus stays on the verse's notes; lift from the band. Rounded, soft consonants, never strained or belted, no vocal edge. Full band, dense and soft: soft grand piano low in its range, pedal held, a warm tape string layer in long notes, low backing harmony in the chorus, tape-saturated bass stepping down, soft kit clearly there, brushes, low toms, dark hats. Harmony Cm9 - Abmaj9 - Ebmaj9 - Bb/D, the chorus opening onto E flat, the last bar an E flat with a sixth added so it reads in either key, no fade. Vocals behind the band, blended in, not upfront. Dark warm tone, highs rolled off, lo-fi texture. About two and a half minutes. No belting, no vocal runs, no saxophone, no smoky bar or lounge, no sultry tone, no autotune, no pop gloss.
